verdict.rationale: Marqeta is API-first, so it is inherently headless. Its Core API covers cards, users, transactions, controls and webhooks. The sandbox provides simulation endpoints for authorizations and reversals, which allow scripted, non-interactive test runs plausibly suited to CI pipelines. However, nothing documents CI usage, and the public sandbox is single-user. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation guidance, an official CLI or SDK for scripted runs, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), documentation of non-interactive auth/credential handling for pipelines, and independent corroboration.
